d0d58709e768ddd0: A single gram of a nickel-titanium (NiTi) shape memory alloy can lift over 1,000 times its own weight when transitioning between its austenite (high-temperature) and martensite (low-temperature) phases, equivalent to a 100 kg person doing a push-up with a single finger.
